id: How are your Pokémon doing?\mMy \TP's really energetic. It's a handful!\mOh yeah, I managed to beat a tough \TE.\mI need to make my party stronger.
en: How are your Pokémon doing?\mMy \TP's really energetic.  It's a handful!\mOh yeah, I managed to beat a tough \TE.\mI need to make my party stronger.
it: Come stanno i tuoi Pokémon?\mIl mio \TP è pieno di energia. Non sta mai fermo!\mAh già, sono riuscito a battere un \TE molto forte.\mDevo rendere più forte la mia squadra.

id: My \TP's looking really awesome.\mI wish I could show you.\mHey, listen! I almost caught a \TE the other day.\mOh, it was sooooooo close, too!
en: My \TP's looking really awesome.\mI wish I could show you.\mHey, listen!  I almost caught a \TE the other day.\mOh, it was sooooooo close, too!
it: Il mio \TP è davvero in gran forma.\mVorrei potertelo mostrare.\mEhi, senti! L'altro giorno ho quasi catturato un \TE.\mOh, c'è mancato davvero pochissimo!

id: Want to battle? It's not going to be a repeat of the last time we met.\mI'll be waiting for you around \TM.
en: Want to battle?  It's not going to be a repeat of the last time we met.\mI'll be waiting for you around \TM.
it: Ti va una lotta? Non finirà come l'ultima volta che ci siamo visti.\mTi aspetto nei dintorni di \TM.

id: Do you want to battle? I'm going to win this time!\mI'll be waiting for you around \TM.\mLook for me, OK? My \TP will be expecting you.
en: Do you want to battle?  I'm going to win this time!\mI'll be waiting for you around \TM.\mLook for me, OK?  My \TP will be expecting you.
it: Vuoi lottare? Stavolta vincerò io!\mTi aspetto nei dintorni di \TM.\mCercami, OK? Il mio \TP ti aspetta.

id: Good morning, \PN.\mThis is \TN. Did I wake you?
en: Good morning, \PN.\mThis is \TN.  Did I wake you?

id: How are you doing? \PN, howdy! This is \TN. Isn't it nice out?
en: How are you doing? \PN, howdy!  This is \TN.  Isn't it nice out?
it: Come va? \PN, salve! Sono \TN. Non è una bella giornata?

id: \PN, good day! It's me, \TN. Got a minute?
en: \PN, good day!  It's me, \TN.  Got a minute?
it: \PN, buongiorno! Sono io, \TN. Hai un minuto?

id: Hello, \PN. This is \TN. How are things?
en: Hello, \PN.  This is \TN.  How are things?
it: Ciao, \PN. Sono \TN. Come vanno le cose?

id: How are your Pokémon doing?\mMy \TP's really energetic. It's a handful!
en: How are your Pokémon doing?\mMy \TP's really energetic.  It's a handful!
it: Come stanno i tuoi Pokémon?\mIl mio \TP è pieno di energia. Non sta mai fermo!

id: How are your Pokémon doing?\mI always keep my \TP in top shape by going to Pokémon Centers.
en: How are your Pokémon doing?\mI always keep my \TP in top shape by going to Pokémon Centers.
it: Come stanno i tuoi Pokémon?\mIo tengo sempre il mio \TP in perfetta forma portandolo ai Centri Pokémon.

id: My \TP's looking really awesome. I wish I could show you.
en: My \TP's looking really awesome.  I wish I could show you.
it: Il mio \TP è davvero in gran forma. Vorrei potertelo mostrare.

id: I dressed my \TP and it looks even cuter than before.
en: I dressed my \TP and it looks even cuter than before.
it: Ho vestito il mio \TP ed è ancora più carino di prima.

id: Oh yeah, I managed to beat a tough \TE.\mI need to make my party stronger.
en: Oh yeah, I managed to beat a tough \TE.\mI need to make my party stronger.
it: Ah già, sono riuscito a battere un \TE molto forte.\mDevo rendere più forte la mia squadra.

id: You have to hear this! I battled \TE the other day.\mIt was easy! I had a type advantage.
en: You have to hear this!  I battled \TE the other day.\mIt was easy!  I had a type advantage.
it: Devi sentire questa! L'altro giorno ho lottato contro \TE.\mÈ stato facile! Avevo il vantaggio del tipo.

id: Hey, listen! I almost caught \TE the other day.\mOh, it was sooooooo close, too!
en: Hey, listen!  I almost caught \TE the other day.\mOh, it was sooooooo close, too!
it: Ehi, senti! L'altro giorno ho quasi catturato \TE.\mOh, c'è mancato davvero pochissimo!

id: Guess what happened the other day. I missed catching \TE again.\mMaybe I'm not very good at this.
en: Guess what happened the other day.  I missed catching \TE again.\mMaybe I'm not very good at this.
it: Indovina cos'è successo l'altro giorno. Mi è sfuggito di nuovo \TE.\mForse non sono molto bravo in questo.
